Shape·Atlas UNI V5

Built, not stored: solids grow from Platonic seeds by truncation, duality, expansion, augmentation and relaxation; compounds are spun from a single seed; curves ride as ribbons and surfaces as shaded parameter grids, all sampled from their equations at load. Every capture of uni v3, uni4 and the iPhone build is here — regrown from its own genome where the equation recorded it, packed to 10 bits where it did not — and anything that scored 99 % or more against a resident was revamped through the dark bridge. Nothing was deleted.
Credits: Császár polyhedron coordinates — Á. Császár (1949), via L. Szilassi; oloid — Paul Schatz (1929); sphericon — C. Roberts / D. Hirsch. Dark Bridge mathematics after the DIA reference document Warp Drive, Dark Energy, and the Manipulation of Extra Dimensions (2010); the zoology ledger after the B.Sc Zoology syllabus (2017). Fweddilleon Specimens live at fweddle.com.
Sources: every name links to its Wikipedia article. Shape lists follow List of polygons, polyhedra and polytopes, List of mathematical shapes, List of uniform polyhedra and The Fifty-Nine Icosahedra. Species: Catalogue of Life. Helices: wwPDB.
